what: A buyer submitted a refund request on May 14, 2025 for the "Safebyte - Technology & IT Solutions WordPress Theme" after discovering a responsiveness issue on Safari for iPhone that severely affects mobile usability.
verbatim_snippet: "Hello Envato Community, I'm posting here regarding a refund request I submitted on May 14, 2025 for the theme: \"Safebyte - Technology & IT Solutions WordPress Theme\" Shortly after purchase, I discovered a responsiveness issue on Safari for iPhone, which severely affects mobile usability."
notes: Envato Community Forums closed permanently August 15, 2025; all forum URLs return 403. Snippet from search engine index tied to this specific thread URL. Username not visible in search snippet. `buyer_review` used as closest value in shard's allowed list for buyer discussion forum posts.
